title: Noncommutative antichain rowmotion transfer factorization on common defined domains for finite posets
author: Michael Joseph; Tom Roby
work: Birational and noncommutative lifts of antichain toggling and rowmotion
source_version: Algebraic Combinatorics 3 (2020), no. 4, 955-984; DOI 10.5802/alco.125; native source SHA256 7bf147ebcda420eb05811d2fe658af294c332c586116076796f766bab030ab7f
difficulty_reason: The noncommutative lift must establish inverse-sensitive local toggle conjugacies with ordered chain products, rather than use commutative involution identities. Its global transfer factorization then combines those new local arguments with lower-ideal induction and commutation of incomparable toggles, on the authored common defined domains. The residual conjugacy and transfer mechanism exceeds an ordinary qualification exercise after finite-poset and skew-field prerequisites.
